WITH major_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
total_members AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(member_count) as REAL) as total FROM major_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(member_count as REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_members) as share,
    member_count
  FROM major_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(member_count) as total_members_in_above_avg_groups,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_of_above_avg_groups,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share)) as avg_distance_above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share)
